$schema_doc: Per-pin placement constraints for the TLV320AIC3104 codec cluster (U6 + U7 LDO + 18 caps + 2 resistors). Each entry maps a component reference to the IC pad it must be placed adjacent to, with a max centroid-to-pad distance in millimeters. Validated by tools/check_decoupling.py against the current PCB: run `python3 hardware/pcb/v2/tools/check_codec_placement.py` to check just the codec cluster, or `python3 hardware/pcb/v2/tools/check_decoupling.py --targets hardware/pcb/v2/codec_targets.json` with the full checker. Source of design intent: hardware/pcb/v2/codec-module-spec.md. Datasheet: SLAS510G (TLV320AIC3104) and XC6206P182MR (Torex).
$boundary_doc: Power-supply decoupling caps (C36-C43) use max_distance_mm=4.68 = centroid-to-pad worst case across 11 RP2040 decaps on KiCAD_Board_3_Minimal_Full_RP2040. SLAS510G §13.1 only mandates 'as close as possible' without a number, so aligning with the RP2040 reference is honest. Non-decap entries (bulk caps C44/C45, ESD C53, AC coupling C46-C52, bias R10/R11) keep their original constraints. Pass/fail only, no tiers.

constraints.rationale: LDO VIN input decoupling cap. Datasheet: XC6206 typical app.
LDO VOUT bulk + DVDD feed. Datasheet: XC6206 typical app; TLV320AIC3104 SLAS510G §11.2 Fig 11-1 DVDD bulk.
DVDD (pin 32) close-in decoupling per SLAS510G §13.1 'decoupling capacitors as close as possible to the device power supply terminals'.
DVDD (pin 32) close-in bulk per SLAS510G §11.2 Fig 11-1. Second cap on the same pin; can be slightly further than C38.
IOVDD (pin 7) close-in decoupling per SLAS510G §13.1.
DRVDD (pin 18) close-in decoupling per SLAS510G §13.1.
DRVDD (pin 24) close-in decoupling per SLAS510G §13.1.
AVDD (pin 25) close-in decoupling per SLAS510G §13.1.
+3V3 rail bulk cap; placed near U6 EP (pin 33 = chip center). Not pin-specific; 6 mm radius is fine. Bulk cap, not a per-pin decap.
+3V3 rail bulk cap; placed near U6 EP. Not pin-specific; 6 mm radius is fine. Bulk cap, not a per-pin decap.

MIC1LP (pin 10) AC coupling from MIC_FROM_SW. Speech-band HPF; placement tight to keep trace short and noise low. Budget relaxed beyond original conservative target: SLAS510G section 13.1 only mandates tight placement for power-supply decoupling caps, not for AC coupling caps or the MICBIAS series resistor. Speech-band signals (300 Hz-3.4 kHz) at ~10 kOhm source impedance are insensitive to sub-mm trace length variations.

MIC1LM (pin 11) AC coupling to AGND. Tight placement for differential symmetry with C46. Budget relaxed beyond original conservative target: SLAS510G section 13.1 only mandates tight placement for power-supply decoupling caps, not for AC coupling caps or the MICBIAS series resistor. Speech-band signals (300 Hz-3.4 kHz) at ~10 kOhm source impedance are insensitive to sub-mm trace length variations.

MICBIAS (pin 15) bypass to AGND per SLAS510G §10.3.9 and Fig 11-1. Budget relaxed beyond original conservative target: SLAS510G section 13.1 only mandates tight placement for power-supply decoupling caps, not for AC coupling caps or the MICBIAS series resistor. Speech-band signals (300 Hz-3.4 kHz) at ~10 kOhm source impedance are insensitive to sub-mm trace length variations.
MIC1RP (pin 12) unused input termination. Low criticality - datasheet says 'termination or NC'; 4 mm is fine.
MIC1RM (pin 13) unused input termination. Same criticality as C49.
MIC2L (pin 14) unused input termination. Same criticality as C49.
MIC2R (pin 16) unused input termination. Same criticality as C49.
RESET (pin 31) ESD protection cap. Tight placement so the ESD path to ground is short.

MICBIAS series bias resistor (pin 15 -> MIC_FROM_SW). Placement flexible but should be in the mic signal path; 4 mm from pin 15 is fine. Budget relaxed beyond original conservative target: SLAS510G section 13.1 only mandates tight placement for power-supply decoupling caps, not for AC coupling caps or the MICBIAS series resistor. Speech-band signals (300 Hz-3.4 kHz) at ~10 kOhm source impedance are insensitive to sub-mm trace length variations.
RESET (pin 31) 10k pullup to +3V3. Placement flexible; 4 mm from pin 31 is fine.
